analysis:
PORTFOLIO REVIEW: Six positions at 86% deployment puts us above the 3-5 concentrated-position target. With only $9,067 of headroom remaining, adding a 7th name would create a stub position too small to move the needle while adding complexity and risk. Market regime is unavailable this cycle, reinforcing a defensive posture.

POSITION-BY-POSITION ASSESSMENT:
• ULTA (+10.89%) and UHS (+11.28%): Both working well and sitting on healthy unrealised gains. Neither appears in this cycle's screened candidates — worth noting, though both may simply have drifted into extended territory. Hold while thesis intact; trail stops mentally.
• ADSK (+6.27%): Modest gain, not in screened list this cycle. No action needed but watch for trend change.
• FOXA (+2.82%): Appears in screened list as UPTREND basing. Thesis intact.
• NXPI (-0.74%): Slight loss but still in screened list as UPTREND basing. No thesis break.
• AMP (-5.11%): YELLOW FLAG. AMP is ABSENT from this cycle's screened candidates, suggesting it may have failed a trend or quality filter. At -5.11% with potential deteriorating trend, this is the highest-priority watch. If the original stop was set at ~8-10% below entry (~$495-$492), it has not triggered yet, but the position deserves tighter monitoring. If weekly price action confirms a downtrend resumption, exit without waiting for the full stop to hit.

NEW TRADES: No new buys proposed this cycle. Reasons: (1) already at 6 positions, above the 3-5 target; (2) only $9,067 headroom — any new position would be a stub too small to size properly per risk rules (1-2% equity at risk); (3) market regime data unavailable — no macro confirmation for new longs; (4) Sortino of -6.00 and a 37.5% win rate with 1.07x profit factor suggest the edge is thin at best — this is exactly the scenario where cash discipline beats forced trades. The screened list has quality names (PODD basing near lows, TXN in strong uptrend, REGN near highs) but PODD is the only genuinely asymmetric setup and there is insufficient capital to size it correctly without over-concentrating. Cash is the correct position today. Revisit when AMP is resolved and a position slot opens.
